title: Plugin Lifecycle Flow
interaction_flow: PluginManager → RepositoryUtils: filterRequiredPackages(packages, rootPackage, true)  [local only]
loop: for each CompletePackage of type composer-plugin/installer
PluginManager → PluginManager: isPluginAllowed(package.getName(), false, optional=true, prompt=false)  [pre-check]
alt: not required and not allowed → io.writeError(warning) + continue
PluginManager → PluginManager: arePluginsDisabled(type)  → return if disabled
alt: API version mismatch → io.writeError(warning) + return
alt: rules==null (legacy lock) AND non-interactive → throw RuntimeException
alt: rules has matching pattern → return allow/deny
alt: not found + interactive → IOInterface: ask('Do you trust X?')
alt: not found + non-interactive → throw PluginBlockedException
PluginManager → PluginManager: loadRepository(globalRepo, isGlobal=true)  [same loop, no rootPackage filter]
loop: for each CompletePackage of type composer-plugin/installer
key_relationships: PluginManager depends_on Composer (getRepositoryManager, getAutoloadGenerator, getConfig, getEventDispatcher, getInstallationManager)
PluginManager depends_on IOInterface (writeError, ask for interactive allow prompt)
PluginInterface defines: activate(Composer, IOInterface), deactivate(Composer, IOInterface), uninstall(Composer, IOInterface)
PluginManager stores: plugins[] array, registeredPlugins[] map, allowPluginRules map, allowGlobalPluginRules map
constructor_init: PluginManager(IOInterface, Composer, ?PartialComposer=null, disablePlugins=false) → parseAllowedPlugins for local and global rules
allow_check_logic: parseAllowedPlugins converts config array to regex→bool map; null means legacy lock (pre-2.2); isPluginAllowed matches package name against patterns; interactive mode prompts user and persists to composer.json; non-interactive without rule throws PluginBlockedException
sorting_weights: composer/installers and packages with plugin-modifies-install-path=true get weight -10000 (load first)
legacy_support: composer-installer type packages loaded same as composer-plugin via registerPackage; InstallerInterface check for oldInstallerPlugin path
important_notes: Plugin API version = 2.9.0 (PluginInterface::PLUGIN_API_VERSION). Class collision handling: if class already loaded, code is eval'd with renamed class (appending _composer_tmpN). Plugins implementing EventSubscriberInterface auto-registered with EventDispatcher. deactivateRepository processes packages in REVERSE sort order. Global plugins use PartialComposer (not full Composer).
